);

With(
    {
        suspension: First(
            Sort(
                Filter(
                    SuspensionDates,
                    Active,
                    EndBlockedDate >= Today()
                ),
                StartBlockedDate
            )
        )
    },
    If(
        !IsBlank(suspension),
        Notify(
            "Due to the " & suspension.Title &
            " the online booking form for Coverage Request Belgium has been temporarily suspended. Power Apps will not process any requests between " &
            Text(suspension.StartBlockedDate, "[$-en-GB]dd/mm/yyyy") &
            " and " &
            Text(suspension.EndBlockedDate, "[$-en-GB]dd/mm/yyyy") &
            ". Please resubmit them through the system once it is operational again on " &
            Text(DateAdd(suspension.EndBlockedDate, 1), "[$-en-GB]dddd dd/mm/yyyy") &
            ".",
            NotificationType.Warning,
            8000
        )
    )
);

// Force fresh fetch from SharePoint, no cached version
Refresh(SuspensionDates);

// Block the suspension window
With(
    {
        matchedSuspension: First(
            Filter(
                SuspensionDates,
                Active,
                EndDatePicker.SelectedDate >= StartBlockedDate,
                EndDatePicker.SelectedDate <= EndBlockedDate
            )
        ),
        rangeOverlap: First(
            Filter(
                SuspensionDates,
                Active,
                StartDatePicker.SelectedDate <= EndBlockedDate,
                EndDatePicker.SelectedDate >= StartBlockedDate
            )
        )
    },
    
    // Case 1: End is before Start
    If(
        !IsBlank(StartDatePicker.SelectedDate) &&
        EndDatePicker.SelectedDate < StartDatePicker.SelectedDate,
        Notify(
            "⚠ The end date cannot be before the start date. Please adjust.",
            NotificationType.Error,
            5000
        ),
        
        // Case 2: End date falls inside a suspension period
        !IsBlank(matchedSuspension),
        Notify(
            "⚠ End date " & Text(EndDatePicker.SelectedDate, "[$-en-GB]dd/mm/yyyy") &
            " is not available. Reason: " & matchedSuspension.Title &
            " (" & Text(matchedSuspension.StartBlockedDate, "[$-en-GB]dd/mm/yyyy") &
            " to " & Text(matchedSuspension.EndBlockedDate, "[$-en-GB]dd/mm/yyyy") & "). " &
            "Please pick a date before " &
            Text(matchedSuspension.StartBlockedDate, "[$-en-GB]dd/mm/yyyy") & " or from " &
            Text(DateAdd(matchedSuspension.EndBlockedDate, 1), "[$-en-GB]dddd dd/mm/yyyy") & " onwards.",
            NotificationType.Warning,
            8000
        ),
        
        // Case 3: The range spans across a suspension period
        !IsBlank(rangeOverlap) && !IsBlank(StartDatePicker.SelectedDate),
        Notify(
            "⚠ Your selected range (" &
            Text(StartDatePicker.SelectedDate, "[$-en-GB]dd/mm/yyyy") & " to " &
            Text(EndDatePicker.SelectedDate, "[$-en-GB]dd/mm/yyyy") &
            ") overlaps with " & rangeOverlap.Title & " (" &
            Text(rangeOverlap.StartBlockedDate, "[$-en-GB]dd/mm/yyyy") & " to " &
            Text(rangeOverlap.EndBlockedDate, "[$-en-GB]dd/mm/yyyy") & "). " &
            "Please adjust the dates.",
            NotificationType.Warning,
            8000
        )
    )
)
